title: Cooking, Health, and Daily Exposure to Pollution Spikes
abstract:
Many routine daily activities—such as cooking and commuting—cause large recurring pollution spikes that may impact health without significantly affecting average exposure. We study pollution spikes by combining experimental variation in cooking technology with high-frequency data on individual pollution exposure and time-use in Kenya. Improved cookstoves reduce PM2.5 spikes while cooking by 51.3 μg/m
3
(41 percent) and cause a 0.24 standard deviation reduction in self-reported respiratory symptoms. However, even after more than three years of daily use, we find no clinical health improvements, possibly because we detect no impact on average exposure. Clinical health improvements may require reductions in ambient concentrations. (JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 许多日常活动（如做饭和通勤）会造成大量反复出现的污染峰值，这些峰值可能影响健康，而对平均暴露水平却没有显著影响。我们结合肯尼亚烹饪技术的实验性变异，以及个人污染暴露和时间使用情况的高频数据，研究了污染峰值。改良炉灶使做饭时的PM2.5峰值降低了51.3微克/立方米（41%），并使自我报告的呼吸道症状降低了0.24个标准差。然而，即便在日常使用超过三年后，我们也未发现临床健康改善，这可能是因为我们未检测到对平均暴露水平的影响。临床健康改善可能需要降低环境浓度。(JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53)

title: The Cost-Effectiveness of Clean Cookstove Carbon Mitigation after Adjusting for Additionality and Impact
abstract: More than 200 million people cook with charcoal daily. This has high climate costs: a Kenyan household using a charcoal stove emits as much CO[Formula: see text] per year as an average U.S. household using a gasoline vehicle. However, concerns around additionality (do subsidies increase sales?) and impact (do sales reduce emissions?) undermine the clean cooking transition. We conduct a randomized trial with 955 households in Nairobi to quantify the additionality and impact of subsidies for an improved cookstove in use by millions of households. Factoring in that 16% of total subsidy spending flows to nonadditional participants, incentivizing one additional stove sale requires US$32 in subsidy spending. Three-and-a-half years later, 83% of buyers own a working improved stove and 11% of nonbuyers do. Factoring in control group adoption and breakage rates, each additional stove generates at least 2.8 additional years of working improved stove ownership. Despite widespread stacking, stove ownership on average abates 1.7 tCO[Formula: see text] per year. Together, the subsidies abate CO[Formula: see text] at US$7 per ton (estimates range between US$3.5 and US$8.1). Each dollar of cookstove subsidy abates 168–383 times more CO[Formula: see text] than a dollar of electric vehicle subsidy.
abstract_zh: 每天有超过2亿人使用木炭做饭。这带来了高昂的气候成本：一个使用木炭炉的肯尼亚家庭每年排放的CO₂，与一个使用汽油车辆的美国普通家庭相当。然而，对附加性（补贴是否增加了销量？）和影响（销量是否减少了排放？）的担忧，削弱了清洁烹饪的转型。我们在内罗毕对955户家庭开展了随机试验，以量化改良炉灶补贴的附加性和影响，该炉灶已被数百万家庭使用。计入总补贴支出中有16%流向了非附加性参与者这一因素后，多售出一台炉灶需要32美元的补贴支出。三年半后，83%的购买者拥有可正常使用的改良炉灶，非购买者中也有11%拥有。计入对照组的采纳率和损坏率后，每台额外炉灶至少可产生2.8年的可正常使用改良炉灶的拥有时间。尽管存在广泛的叠加使用（stacking）现象，但平均而言，炉灶拥有每年可减排1.7 tCO₂。综合来看，这些补贴以每吨7美元的成本减排CO₂（估计区间为3.5至8.1美元）。每投入一美元的炉灶补贴，减排的CO₂是每投入一美元电动汽车补贴的168至383倍。

title: Contracting Structures in Public Procurement: Evidence from Donor-Funded Electrification in Kenya
abstract: We study how contracting and monitoring structures in public procurement affect large-scale infrastructure construction. Starting in 2016, Kenya’s public electric utility ran competitive auctions and then awarded and administered dozens of procurement contracts to connect millions to electricity. The causal analyses leverage natural and experimental variation and granular, independentlycollected construction quality data. Kenya Power contracts funded by the World Bank featured unbundled contract components known as ‘design-bid-build’ and enhanced monitoring compared to African Development Bank-funded contracts. Unbundling contracts delayed construction progress but improved quality. Randomized inspections improved quality without large delays. Bundled contracting with additional independent monitoring could improve outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了公共采购中的合同与监督结构如何影响大规模基础设施建设。从2016年开始，肯尼亚的公营电力公司进行了竞争性招标，随后授予并管理了数十份采购合同，以使数百万人接入电网。因果分析利用了自然和实验性变异，以及经独立收集的精细施工质量数据。与非洲开发银行资助的合同相比，世界银行资助的肯尼亚电力公司合同具有被称为“设计—招标—建造”的分拆合同组成部分，且监督更为严格。分拆合同延缓了施工进度，但提高了质量。随机检查在未造成大量延误的情况下提高了质量。捆绑式合同并辅以独立监督，可能改善结果。

title: Distribution Grid Constraints on Africa's Energy Transition: Customer-Level Evidence from High-Frequency Power-Quality Measurements
Green Subsidies with Demand Distortions
abstract: Credit constraints and other demand distortions are pervasive in lower-income contexts.A model of clean technology adoption shows that demand distortions can increase the welfare gains from green subsidies. This arises through two channels: shifting the marginal adopter toward higher private and social benefits, and increasing demand elasticity. We test this by cross-randomizing purchase price subsidies, usage subsidies, and access to an interest-free loan for a US$84 induction stove among 2,134 charcoal users in Kenya. Usage subsidies of 75% have a precise zero effect on adoption and usage. Purchase price subsidies, however, generate large welfare gains. Credit constraints raise the subsidy's efficacy by 35%-73%, up to US$10-US$12 in observable welfare gain per subsidy dollar. This demand distortion also lowers the subsidy cost of abatement by 41%, to US$12 per tCO2e.This operates through the two channels identified in the theory: credit constraints raise the marginal adopter's positive externality by 19% and fuel savings by 30%, and lower the subsidy cost per marginal adoption by 29%.In a counterfactual without demand distortions, the abatement cost rises to US$137 per tCO2e.Contexts with large demand distortions could offer many cost-effective opportunities for climate change mitigation financing.
abstract_zh: 在低收入环境中，信贷约束和其他需求扭曲普遍存在。一个关于清洁技术采用的模型表明，需求扭曲可以增加绿色补贴的福利收益。这一效应通过两条渠道产生：一是将边际采用者转向私人收益和社会收益更高的群体；二是提高需求弹性。我们在肯尼亚对2,134名木炭使用者进行了交叉随机化实验，针对一款售价84美元的电磁炉，随机分配了购买价格补贴、使用补贴以及免息贷款机会。75%的使用补贴对采用和使用行为的影响精确为零。然而，购买价格补贴却带来了巨大的福利收益。信贷约束使补贴效力提高了35%–73%，每单位补贴美元可产生的可观测福利收益最高达10–12美元。这种需求扭曲还使减排的补贴成本降低了41%，降至每吨二氧化碳当量（tCO2e）12美元。这一效应通过理论中所指出的两条渠道发挥作用：信贷约束使边际采用者的正外部性提高了19%，燃料节省提高了30%，并使每次边际采用的补贴成本降低了29%。在不存在需求扭曲的反事实情境中，减排成本将升至每吨tCO2e 137美元。存在较大需求扭曲的地区，可能为气候变化减缓融资提供大量具有成本效益的机会。

title: Integrity and Unraveling in Carbon Offset Markets
Money or Power? Choosing Covid-19 Aid in Kenya
Credit, Attention, and Externalities in the Adoption of Energy Efficient Technologies by Low-Income Households
abstract: We study an energy efficient charcoal cookstove in an experiment with 1,000 households in Nairobi. We estimate a 39 percent reduction in charcoal spending, which matches engineering estimates, generating a 295 percent annual return. Despite fuel savings of $237 over the stove’s two-year lifespan—and $295 in emissions reductions—households are only willing to pay $12. Drawing attention to energy savings does not increase demand. However, a loan more than doubles willingness to pay: credit constraints prevent adoption of privately optimal technologies. Energy efficient technologies could drive sustainable development by slowing greenhouse emissions while saving households money. (JEL D12, D91, G51, O12, O13, O32, Q54)
abstract_zh: 我们在内罗毕的1,000户家庭中开展实验，研究一种高能效木炭炉灶。我们估计木炭支出减少了39%，与工程估计相符，相当于295%的年化回报率。尽管该炉灶在两年使用寿命内可节省237美元的燃料费用，并减少价值295美元的排放，家庭愿意支付的价格仅为12美元。提请对节能收益的关注并不能增加需求。然而，贷款使支付意愿增加了一倍多：信贷约束阻碍了私人最优技术的采用。高能效技术既能减缓温室气体排放，又能为家庭节省开支，从而推动可持续发展。（JEL D12, D91, G51, O12, O13, O32, Q54）

title: Disbursing Emergency Relief through Utilities: Evidence from Ghana
Electric Heating and the Effects of Temperature on Household Electricity Consumption in South Africa
abstract: How does temperature affect household energy demand in low-income countries? This paper uses 132,375,282 hourly electricity consumption observations from 5,975 households in South Africa to estimate the causal effects of short-term temperature changes on household electricity consumption. The estimates flexibly identify a constant log-linear temperature response—for every 1ଌ increase in temperature, electricity consumption decreases by 4.1% among temperatures below the heating threshold but increases by 8.1% among temperatures above the cooling threshold. This relationship is driven more strongly by seasonal than hourly temperature changes. Holding all else constant, a 3.25ଌ increase in temperatures would reduce electricity consumption by 1,093.4 kWh (6.2%) per year per household. Widespread use of electric heating due to limited residential gas heating infrastructure likely drives this. These results point to important regional heterogeneity in how temperature increases may affect household energy demand in the coming decades.
abstract_zh: 气温如何影响低收入国家的家庭能源需求？本文利用南非5,975户家庭的132,375,282条每小时用电量观测数据，估计短期气温变化对家庭用电量的因果效应。估计结果灵活地识别出一种恒定的对数线性气温响应：气温每升高1°C，低于供暖阈值的气温区间内用电量下降4.1%，而高于制冷阈值的气温区间内用电量上升8.1%。这一关系受季节性气温变化的影响比受每小时气温变化的影响更为显著。在其他条件不变的情况下，气温升高3.25°C，每户家庭每年的用电量将减少1,093.4千瓦时（6.2%）。由于住宅燃气供暖基础设施有限，电采暖的广泛使用很可能是造成这一现象的原因。这些结果表明，在未来几十年中，气温上升对家庭能源需求的影响可能存在重要的区域异质性。
